service: hybrid-rag
frameworkVersion: "4"

plugins:
  - serverless-localstack

provider:
  name: aws
  region: ${opt:region, 'us-east-1'}
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'local'}
  ecr:
    images:
      application:
        path: .
  environment:
    AWS_REGION: ${self:provider.region}
    DOCUMENT_BUCKET:
      Ref: DocumentBucket
    DOCUMENTS_TABLE:
      Ref: DocumentsTable
    RAG_TABLE:
      Ref: RagTable
    SQS_QUEUE_URL:
      Ref: IngestionQueue
  iam:
    role:
      statements:
        - Effect: Allow
          Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject]
          Resource:
            - Fn::Join: ["", ["arn:aws:s3:::", { Ref: DocumentBucket }, "/*"]]
        - Effect: Allow
          Action: [dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan, dynamodb:DeleteItem, dynamodb:BatchWriteItem]
          Resource:
            - Fn::GetAtt: [DocumentsTable, Arn]
            - Fn::GetAtt: [RagTable, Arn]

functions:
  api:
    image:
      name: application
      command: [handlers.api_handler]
    memorySize: 2048
    timeout: 30
    events:
      - httpApi: "GET /health"
      - httpApi: "POST /documents/upload-url"
      - httpApi: "GET /documents/{document_id}"
      - httpApi: "POST /queries"
  ingest:
    image:
      name: application
      command: [workers.sqs_worker.handler]
    memorySize: 4096
    timeout: 300
    events:
      - sqs:
          arn:
            Fn::GetAtt: [IngestionQueue, Arn]
          batchSize: 1
          functionResponseType: ReportBatchItemFailures

custom:
  localstack:
    stages: [local]

resources:
  Resources:
    DocumentsTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: document_id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: document_id
            KeyType: HASH
    RagTable:
      Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
      Properties:
        BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
        AttributeDefinitions:
          - AttributeName: parent_id
            AttributeType: S
          - AttributeName: record_id
            AttributeType: S
        KeySchema:
          - AttributeName: parent_id
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: record_id
            KeyType: RANGE
    IngestionDeadLetterQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    IngestionQueue:
      Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
      Properties:
        VisibilityTimeout: 360
        RedrivePolicy:
          deadLetterTargetArn:
            Fn::GetAtt: [IngestionDeadLetterQueue, Arn]
          maxReceiveCount: 3
    DocumentBucket:
      Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
      Properties:
        NotificationConfiguration:
          QueueConfigurations:
            - Event: s3:ObjectCreated:*
              Filter:
                S3Key:
                  Rules:
                    - Name: prefix
                      Value: uploads/
              Queue:
                Fn::GetAtt: [IngestionQueue, Arn]
    IngestionQueuePolicy:
      Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
      Properties:
        Queues:
          - Ref: IngestionQueue
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: "2012-10-17"
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: s3.amazonaws.com
              Action: sqs:SendMessage
              Resource:
                Fn::GetAtt: [IngestionQueue, Arn]
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  aws:SourceAccount:
                    Ref: AWS::AccountId
